name: drakeskin
lore_descriptor: blue-gray scales, soft as silk, hard to cut
first_pickup_chronicle: Drakeskin. Not a true dragon — a drake, the smaller cousin. The scales are softer but the fire-resistance is real. Better than mail in a furnace.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.35, weight_mult 0.75, no effective_against (T4 leather). Has elemental resistance. Bridges into dragonhide.
